title: 第19章 阴阳自修第20章 民调局
content_zh:
;;
话分两头。
敖鹏给敖武传了一堆自己用不上的破铜烂铁之后，开始研究他自己。
因为他长毛了。
字面意义上的长毛。
单身公寓内，敖鹏脱下衣服，露出一副如同大师雕刻的身体，只不过这具完美无瑕的身体之上，长满一层白绒绒的细毛。
长毛的一瞬间，敖鹏就猜到了原因。
他看向胸膛的挂坠，玉蝉在灯光的照耀下，通透光亮，但是却没有半点羊脂玉的暖意，反而散发着阴邪的气息。
【死蜕玉蝉】，长时间佩戴之后，会被上面的尸气影响，身体会逐渐尸化。
原本敖鹏自己就是还魂尸，所以他并不担心尸化问题，一直就戴在脖子上。
但现在看来，这种尸化已经向着白僵开始转变了。
“这种转变会不会太快了一点？”
敖鹏自语道，回想起他今晚干了什么事情。
他身体吸收了大量迎人体内的阴气，这与他自身特性，玉蝉尸气结合，所以一同产生了这种奇特而又迅速的转变。
敖鹏连忙到洗手间，拿起刮胡刀想要刮去身上的白毛。
他白天还要上学呢，不可能永远待在这间公寓里。
只不过这层白毛虽然看似柔软，但是就像是一层老牛皮一样，刮胡刀根本刮不下来，而且被刮的时候，敖鹏竟然有一种在刮身体一部分的错觉。
刮了这层白毛，对他有害无益！
敖鹏坐在床上思考了一会儿，然后他双腿盘坐，闭目观想。
一缕缕香火被他吸收，然后与自身血液一同流入小腹下四指处。

一片看不清的黑暗中，香火和血液勾连，形成燃料。
一缕缕如同青烟一样的热气开始从小腹升腾，一圈一圈扩散，从毛孔中外散开来。
修行了一圈拙火禅之后，敖鹏睁开眼，看向肚脐眼的地方，那里一小圈的白绒在拙火禅阳气灼烧下消融了，但也仅仅只有小腹两指宽的距离。
他看了一眼时间，不知不觉竟然过去了两个小时，而且这种消融法对于他自身竟然有种损害的感觉。
并没有成功修炼的神清气爽，反倒是身体莫名有种亏空。
他之前的直觉是对的。
他是还魂尸，而且是已经开始转化成为白僵的还魂尸。
除非他想要永远停留在还魂尸的境界，不然这层白绒他不能够直接消融。
“或许可以尝试另外一种办法。”
敖鹏看向技能中的【黄帝素女经】，这门传自道家祖师黄帝的绝学可不只是用来降妖伏魔。
降妖伏魔的背后是阐述天地之间的阴阳至理。
其实如果迎人真的愿意和敖鹏修行，【黄帝素女经】不仅不会损害迎人的道行，反而会增进双方的道行。
可惜的是迎人只想要吸收敖鹏体内的拙火禅定，结果吸收不成功，反而被自身的欢喜禅定反噬，所以一身阴气才全部都给了敖鹏作嫁衣。
正常修行【黄帝素女经】，肯定是需要男女配合，但是男女本身也只是阴阳象征的一种表现形式。
敖鹏作为还魂尸，本身就具备阴阳两者的特点。
加上他的【黄帝素女经】已经进入了掌握层次，自身对于阴阳也有了初步的理解。
“如果以拙火禅定为阳，自身的白僵绒毛为阴，是不是可以形成某种自循环？”

The words are divided into two parts.
After Ao Peng passed Ao Wu a bunch of junk that he couldn't use, he began to study himself.
Because he has grown hair.
Literally hairy.
In the bachelor's apartment, Ao Peng took off his clothes, revealing a body that looked like a master's sculpture. However, this flawless body was covered with a layer of fine white hair.
The moment the hair grew, Ao Peng guessed the reason.
He looked at the pendant on his chest. Under the light of the light, the jade cicada was transparent and bright, but it did not have the slightest warmth of mutton-fat jade. Instead, it exuded an evil aura.
[Death Sloughing Jade Cicada], after wearing it for a long time, will be affected by the corpse energy on it, and the body will gradually transform into a corpse.
Originally, Ao Peng himself was a resurrected corpse, so he was not worried about the problem of corpse transformation and kept wearing it around his neck.
But now it seems that this zombie transformation has begun to change towards white zombies.
“Is this transition a little too quick?”
Ao Peng said to himself, recalling what he did tonight.
His body absorbed a large amount of Yin Qi from Yingren's body, which combined with his own characteristics, the Jade Cicada Corpse Qi, resulted in this strange and rapid transformation.
Ao Peng quickly went to the bathroom and picked up a razor to shave off the white hair on his body.
He has to go to school during the day and can't stay in this apartment forever.
It's just that although this layer of white hair looks soft, it is like a layer of old cowhide that cannot be scraped off by a razor. Moreover, when being shaved, Ao Peng actually had the illusion that he was shaving part of his body.
Shaving this layer of white hair will do more harm than good to him!
Ao Peng sat on the bed and thought for a while, then he sat cross-legged and closed his eyes to meditate.
Wisps of incense were absorbed by him, and then flowed into the four fingers under his lower abdomen together with his own blood.
In the darkness where one cannot see clearly, incense and blood connect to form fuel.
Wisps of hot air like green smoke began to rise from the lower abdomen, spreading in circles and spreading out from the pores.
After practicing a circle of Kunluo Fire Zen, Ao Peng opened his eyes and looked at his belly button. A small circle of white velvet there had melted under the burning of Yang Qi of Kunluo Fire Zen, but it was only two finger widths away from his lower abdomen.
He glanced at the time and found that two hours had passed before he knew it, and this ablation method actually felt harmful to him.
Instead of feeling refreshed and refreshed after successful cultivation, my body felt inexplicably deficient.
His previous intuition was right.
He is a resurrected corpse, and he is a resurrected corpse that has begun to transform into white zombies.
Unless he wants to stay in the state of a resurrected corpse forever, he cannot directly dissolve this layer of white velvet.
"Maybe we can try another approach."
Ao Peng looked at the [Huangdi Su Nu Sutra] among the skills. This unique skill passed down from the Taoist founder Huangdi is not only used to subjugate demons.
Behind the subjugation of demons is the elaboration of the principles of yin and yang between heaven and earth.
In fact, if Yingren is really willing to practice with Ao Peng, the "Huangdi Su Nv Sutra" will not only not harm Yingren's Taoism, but will enhance the Taoism of both parties.
It's a pity that Yingren only wanted to absorb the Kunluo Fire Meditation in Ao Peng's body, but the absorption failed. Instead, it was backfired by his own Joy Meditation, so all the Yin Qi in his body was given to Ao Peng as a wedding dress.
Normal practice of the Yellow Emperor's Sutra definitely requires the cooperation of men and women, but men and women themselves are just a manifestation of the yin and yang symbol.
As a resurrected corpse, Ao Peng possesses the characteristics of both yin and yang.
In addition, he has reached the level of mastery of the [Huangdi Su Nu Jing], and he has a preliminary understanding of Yin and Yang.
“If we use the Kundalini Fire Meditation as the yang, and our own white stiff hair as the yin, can we form some kind of self-circulation?”
